description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to amend the Rules Setout in the Excise Duty on import of non portable Sprits, published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 2044/33 of 09.11.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification amends excise rules under the Excise Ordinance, specifically modifying duty rates for imported raw materials used by export-oriented manufacturing companies. It constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation (Excise Notification No. 999), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
